about.title: About us
about.description: We connect Spanish quality with Mauritanian customers, delivering premium products with care and reliability.

story.title: Where it started
story.paragraph1: We started with a simple idea: make products we love in Spain easy to buy in Mauritania. Our selection covers skincare, bags, shoes and beauty, chosen one product at a time.
story.paragraph2: We understand the importance of trust in online shopping, which is why we offer personal WhatsApp communication — so you can ask questions, see additional photos, and feel confident before making a purchase.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.description: To provide authentic Spanish products with exceptional service and reliable delivery.
